description: This file defines an abstract base class 'XBrush' used for filling the interiors of paths in the PDFsharp library, with platform-specific methods for realizing brushes in GDI, WPF, and UWP environments. It includes implicit conversions from System.Drawing.Brush to XBrush for GDI.

classes.name: XBrush
classes.description: An abstract class that defines objects used to fill the interiors of paths, with platform-specific realization methods.

methods.name: RealizeGdiBrush
methods.description: Abstract method to convert XBrush to System.Drawing.Brush for GDI.

methods.name: Implicit operator XBrush
methods.description: Converts a System.Drawing.Brush to an XBrush, supporting SolidBrush with color.

methods.name: RealizeWpfBrush
methods.description: Abstract method to convert XBrush to System.Windows.Media.Brush for WPF.

methods.name: RealizeCanvasBrush
methods.description: Abstract method to convert XBrush to ICanvasBrush for UWP.
